convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorZerolagMomentumOSMA indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution (open/close/position sizing), making automatic conversion impossible without reimplementing the custom indicator and trading library logic.

TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timestamping

DnSignalTime - timestamp for sell signal bar

other_exits: Opposite direction signal triggers close of existing position when BuyPosClose or SellPosClose is enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lot size, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM input (0.1) is the fraction or lot depending on mode.

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a 3-bar window of the custom ColorZerolagMomentumOSMA indicator (buffer values at shifts SignalBar, SignalBar+1, SignalBar+2). Trend direction is determined by comparing buffer[1] vs buffer[2]: if buffer[1]<buffer[2] the trend is up, if buffer[1]>buffer[2] the trend is down. Entry within the trend requires momentum confirmation: for long, buffer[0]>buffer[1] (rising OSMA in uptrend); for short, buffer[0]<buffer[1] (falling OSMA in downtrend). SignalBar defaults to 1 meaning signals are calculated on the previous completed bar. The Recount flag forces recalculation if CopyBuffer fails. When SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated on every tick without new-bar guard. Trade execution is entirely delegated to TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) which handle position management internally including potential duplicate position checks.
python_conversion_notes: The custom ColorZerolagMomentumOSMA indicator must be fully reimplemented in Python. It is a weighted composite of 5 momentum oscillators with different periods (8,21,34,55,89) and factors (0.43,0.26,0.16,0.10,0.05), smoothed twice and displayed as OSMA (histogram of signal line divergence). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library must also be reimplemented - it encapsulates all trade execution including 5 margin mode calculations (MM on free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, fixed lot), position opening with signal time tracking, position closing, and deviation handling. The EA's signal logic itself (3-bar comparison pattern) is straightforward once the indicator and trade functions are available. SL/TP of 1000/2000 points likely need digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers (divide by 10 to get 100/200 pips) - verify during conversion.
